<translate>
'''Turles''' is the world boss of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. The Saiyan waits in the clearing under the [[Special:MyLanguage/Tree of Might|Tree of Might]], eats its fruit for a damage boost in the middle of the fight, and can teach you two of his techniques. With 72,000 health he is the most approachable of the world bosses.
</translate>

<translate>
== The Tree of Might ==

The [[Special:MyLanguage/Tree of Might|Tree of Might]] is a giant tree whose canopy is about 340 blocks wide. It grows in a swamp at least 1,000 blocks from 0, 0, and there is only one per world. Its wood and roots are unbreakable, and its rare glowing fruit drops the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fruit of the Tree of Might|Fruit of the Tree of Might]]. The clearing under it is Turles's lair. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Structures]].

The lair is only set up once the tree has been generated. In worlds created before the tree was added, it is still placed where DMZ planned it when a player loads that area; it is too big to place at once, so it is filled in gradually and visibly grows. When an operator resets the boss, the tree is restored too.
</translate>

<translate>
== The fight ==

Turles fights up close and at range, and can Zanzoken out of the way of your hits.

* '''Fruit of Might.''' Partway through the fight he eats a Fruit of Might: he glows red and, for 30 seconds, deals 50% more melee damage and strikes much faster. He can eat another one 90 seconds after the boost ends.
* '''Kill Driver.''' He forms a ring of ki and throws it at a target he can see between 6 and 40 blocks away.
* '''Meteor Burst.''' At close range he seizes a player and pounds them with a long combo of strikes, a slam and ki blasts.
* '''Grab.''' He dashes at a nearby player (up to about 8 blocks away), grabs them, swings them around four times and throws them.
</translate>

<translate>
== Rewards ==

Every contributor rolls these default rewards (see [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses#Rewards|how world boss rewards work]]):
* '''50,000 TP''' (guaranteed; the amount scales with your contribution).
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Fruit of the Tree of Might|Fruit of the Tree of Might]] (50%): a powerful temporary power boost (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Items|Items]]).
* The '''Kill Driver''' technique (25%): a ki disk attack (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Attacks|Ki Attacks]]).
* The [[Special:MyLanguage/Meteor Burst|Meteor Burst]] technique (15%): a long strike combo (6 seconds) that mixes strikes, a slam and ki blasts, and scales with both SKP and PWR (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Strike Attacks|Strike Attacks]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==

The [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] has its own Tree of Might chapter in Earth's Rocky biome, after Saiyan Saga quest 12: '''Tree of Might Wasteland''', '''Turles' Goku''' and the fight against '''Turles''' himself.
</translate>
